blocks.prompt: 8. A particle moving in a straight line starts from rest and is accelerated uniformly to attain a velocity of 30 km/h in 5 seconds. Find the distance travelled by the particle in the last three seconds.
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke sawal kis qisam ka hai: particle rest se chalta hai aur acceleration uniform (har second barabar) hai, is liye teeno equations of motion yahan lag sakti hain.
Diya kya hai? \(u = 0\), aur 5 second baad \(v = 30\) km/h.
Find kya karna hai? Aakhri teen seconds mein tay kiya gaya distance, yani \(t = 2\) s se \(t = 5\) s tak ka safar.
Rule kaunsa? Pehle \(v = u + at\) se acceleration, phir \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^2\) se har waqt ki position.
Plan: unit ko m/s mein badlein, \(a\) nikalein, phir \(x(5)\) mein se \(x(2)\) minus kar dein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(u = 0\), \(t = 5\) s par \(v = 30\) km/h, acceleration uniform hai.
Maloom karna: aakhri teen seconds ka distance, yani \(t = 2\) s se \(t = 5\) s tak.
Tareeqa: Acceleration constant hai, is liye \(v = u + at\) se \(a\) milega aur \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^2\) se kisi bhi waqt ki position. Aakhri 3 seconds ka distance seedha \(x(5) - x(2)\) hai, bilkul aise jaise kisi safar mein 5 bajay ki position se 2 bajay ki position minus kar dein.

km/h ko m/s mein badlein
\[v = 30 \times \dfrac{1000}{3600}\]
\[v = \dfrac{25}{3}\ \text{m/s}\]
Kyun: Time seconds mein diya hai, is liye velocity bhi metre per second mein honi chahiye, warna units aapas mein mix ho jayenge. 1 km = 1000 m aur 1 ghanta = 3600 s, yani km/h ko m/s banane ke liye 5/18 se multiply karte hain.
Dhyan dein: Bohat se students yeh conversion bhool kar seedha 30 rakh dete hain; phir poora jawab ghalat ho jata hai.

Acceleration nikalein
\[\dfrac{25}{3} = 0 + a(5)\]
\[a = \dfrac{25}{15} = \dfrac{5}{3}\ \text{m/s}^2\]
Kyun: \(v = u + at\) mein \(u\), \(v\) aur \(t\) teeno maloom hain aur sirf \(a\) unknown hai, is liye yahi equation sab se munasib hai. Dono taraf 5 se divide kiya aur fraction ko chhota kiya.

Har waqt ki position
\[x(t) = 0 + \dfrac{1}{2} \cdot \dfrac{5}{3}t^2\]
\[x(t) = \dfrac{5}{6}t^2\]
Kyun: \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^2\) mein \(u = 0\) rakha, kyunke particle rest se chala tha. \(x\) starting point se naapa ja raha hai. Ab yeh ek formula hai jis mein koi bhi \(t\) rakh kar position mil jati hai.

t = 5 s aur t = 2 s par position
\[x(5) = \dfrac{5}{6}(25) = \dfrac{125}{6}\ \text{m}\]
\[x(2) = \dfrac{5}{6}(4) = \dfrac{20}{6}\ \text{m}\]
Kyun: Poora safar 5 second ka hai; aakhri 3 second \(t = 5 - 3 = 2\) s se shuru hote hain. Is liye humein do positions chahiye: shuru (\(t = 2\)) aur aakhir (\(t = 5\)).

Aakhri teen seconds ka distance
\[x(5) - x(2) = \dfrac{125 - 20}{6}\]
\[= \dfrac{105}{6} = 17.5\ \text{m}\]
Kyun: Velocity \(v = \frac{5}{3}t\) kabhi negative nahi hoti, yani particle kabhi wapas nahi mudta. Jab body ek hi taraf chalti rahe to distance aur position ka farq barabar hote hain, is liye seedha minus kar diya.

Tasdeeq
\[v(2) = \dfrac{5}{3}(2) = \dfrac{10}{3}\ \text{m/s}\]
\[x = \dfrac{10}{3}(3) + \dfrac{1}{2} \cdot \dfrac{5}{3}(3)^2\]
\[= 10 + 7.5 = 17.5\ \text{m}\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: Doosre tareeqe se socha: aakhri 3 seconds ko ek naya safar samjhein jo \(t = 2\) s wali velocity se shuru hota hai. Isi \(x = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^2\) se wohi 17.5 m aaya, is liye jawab pakka hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab Exercise 7.1 ka koi answer print nahi karti, is liye yeh jawab hamara apna hai. Humne isay computer algebra (sympy) se aur ek alag hal kiye gaye solution se alag alag check kiya hai, is liye aap is par bharosa kar sakte hain. Phir bhi apna jawab khud check karne ki aadat zaroor daliye. Aam ghalti: pehle teen seconds ka distance \(x(3) = 7.5\) m hai; sawal aakhri teen seconds ka pooch raha hai, pehle teen ka nahi.
